text: A natural transformation α: F ⇒ G assigns to each c a morphism αc: F(c)→G(c) satisfying:
choices: G(f) ∘ αc = αc' ∘ F(f) for all f: c→c' (naturality square)
α is the identity on objects
explanation: Naturality = coherence: the transformation commutes with all morphisms in the source category.
